# XY Forever serial protocol 1.30: saved inputs

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.30](../PROTOCOL.md).

### 0x4d `config.get`

Read the saved inputs: mod selection, safe mode, Mod memory. Reads the saved record (`config.txt`, else `config.old`) fresh from storage; changes nothing.
`busy` while the device converges before a boot or a job holds the storage. These are the inputs a plain power-on converges to (builds, installs content, sets
the default) before it boots: docs/storage/state.md.

| Request field (4 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | API version: 1; newer is unsupported |

| Reply field, after the status (22 to 2132 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | reply format: 1 |
| `record` | u32 | 1: `config.txt` (or `config.old`) is saved; 0: none (no mods, the default stock entry boots) (0..1) |
| `count` | u32 | mods selected |
| `flags` | u32 | bit 0: Mod memory is the 4 MiB layout; bit 1: safe mode (the base boots with its official content, the selection kept); bit 2: an unknown base is allowed (0..7) |
| `saving` | u32 | 0 = saved: the fields are what boots next; 1 = a set (or a Mods-page flip) waits for its quiet moment or is being written; 2 = the last write failed: the next set or flip writes it again. The write of the latest set |
| `base` | cstr ASCII, 1..32 B | the stock library entry the setup is built on (empty: none in the library) |
| `generation` | cstr ASCII, 1..32 B | the mod package set the selection is from (empty: none saved) |
| `mods` | text ASCII, 0..2048 B | the selection as saved: machine folders, then `ext-<id>`, comma-separated (empty: none) |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `unsupported`, `busy`, `link`, `storage`. The reply never gains fields (it ends in `text`). Tool timeout:
30 s. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.24.

### 0x4e `config.set`

Save the mod selection, safe mode and Mod memory (built at the next boot). As if the Mods page's toggles were flipped on the device. The first request reads the
package list fresh and answers `busy` until that is done: send the same request again. It then checks that the selection can be built (every name a package of
the set, within Mod memory, a stock base in the library, which has its content set or can get it at the build: an official OS 1.2.1 entry, the content official)
and answers `refused` with the reason, changing nothing; or `ok`, and the record is written at the next quiet moment as a flip on the page is (`config.get`
`saving`). It never builds and never changes the default: the next boot converges to it (docs/storage/state.md). `busy` also while the device converges, a job
runs, or a flip on the page is not written yet.

| Request field (41 to 2088 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | API version: 1; newer is unsupported |
| `flags` | u32 | bit 0: the 4 MiB Mod memory layout; bit 1: safe mode on (needs a built selection: the base boots with its official content), off when clear; bit 2: allow an unknown base (0..7) |
| `mods` | cstr ASCII, 1..2048 B | the selection: package folder names of the newest complete package set (machines; extensions as `ext-<id>`), comma-separated (empty: no mods) |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | confirmation: the SHA-256 of every request byte before it |

| Reply field, after the status (4 to 84 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | reply format: 1 |
| `reason` | text ASCII, 0..80 B | with `refused`: why the selection cannot be built, as the Mods page says it; else empty |

On an error: every field (zero where not reached). Errors: `bad_request`, `unsupported`, `sha`, `link`, `refused`. The reply never gains fields (it ends in
`text`). Tool timeout: 30 s. **Destructive**: ask the user first. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since
1.24.

### 0x4f `packs.manage`

Import or toggle a .tfw sound pack and inspect progress. Import decrypts the .tfw with the device's key, checks every member's CRC-32 and SHA-256 (not the .tfw
signature, since 1.29) and publishes one complete kept pack. Poll status until completion. Cancel while opening or staging leaves the current packs intact.
Enable moves a retained pack into the live packs (not tested on this firmware).

| Request field (9 to 136 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | API version 1 |
| `operation` | u32 | 0 status, 1 import, 2 cancel, 3 enable, 4 disable, 5 status with B's request log, 6 status with the last import's timing (since 1.28) (0..6) |
| `name` | cstr ASCII, 1..128 B | Inbox .tfw basename to import, pack ID to toggle, empty for status or cancel |

| Reply field, after the status (32 to 544 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | u32 | Whether the request was accepted |
| `phase` | u32 | 0 idle, 1 opening (reading the archive's directory; before 1.29 authenticating the .tfw), 2 staging, 3 complete, 4 failed |
| `done` | u32 | Pack files staged (0 while opening) |
| `total` | u32 | Pack files to stage (0 while opening) |
| `error` | u32 | Final import status when phase is failed |
| `site` | u32 | Where a failed import stopped: the job step << 8 \| the call (1 open, 2 extract, 3 write, 4 close), plus 0x10000 source close failed, 0x20000 link lost, 0x40000 scratch cleanup started; 0 otherwise |
| `detail` | u32 | For a failure: the archive member << 16 \| A's errno, 0x8000 \| a link outcome, or the blob step |
| `traced` | u32 | Entries of B's request log kept when the last import failed (0: none), operation 5 returns them |
| `trace` | rest, 0..512 B | Operation 5: `traced` entries of B's log of its last requests to A, 4 u32 each (`file_client::log_add`, target/file_client.hpp), oldest first. Operation 6: the last import's timing on B, u32 each: the bucket count n, n sums in units of 1024 cycles of the 400 MHz clock, then the source reads, pieces put, members written and member bytes (`PackClock`, target/usb_service_pack_import.ipp; 1.29 dropped the first bucket, A's hash). Decoder: `xy_forever/pack_change.py` |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `unsupported`, `busy`, `link`, `storage`, `state`, `not_found`, `refused`. The reply never gains fields (it
ends in `rest`). Tool timeout: 60 s. **Destructive**: ask the user first. Build switch `XYF_TFW_CHECK` (on in product builds; without it: `unsupported`). Since
1.27.
